notes: 02: only title+description parsed (og/meta); no favicon or preview image collected, and description is discarded (not stored). 03: title editable before/after save, but description is never stored so cannot be edited. 04: update() edits title/note/tags only; url and description are not editable. 05: no delete route or store method at all. 07: list shows title/tags/note and a letter-avatar placeholder, but no real favicon and no description. 10: tag input is a plain field with Enter-to-add; no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. 14: search is plain substring over a joined haystack; '#tag' prefix is not parsed (tags stored without #). 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. 20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. 22: list is fixed newest-first (unshift); no sort key selection or control. 23: note is stored but rendered as escaped plain text (pre-wrap), not rendered markdown. 24/25: no snapshot/PDF or Internet Archive support. 27: archive is reversible, but delete does not exist so the archive-vs-delete distinction is only half realised. 29: no bundles/saved filters. 30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. 32: no user/display settings (sort, items-per-page, font size).
